decision.rule: pre-registered (cycle 26 P4). Both harder statistics are judged at the documented D6 bar (5%), on the SAME harness, seeds and record order as the committed N3 artifact, and the collector must REPRODUCE all three committed skill numbers exactly at the committed budget before either is trusted (the instrument gate raises otherwise). E: the qtable's empirical regret against the incumbent frozen reactive rule's regret over the same bucket means - beats_incumbent_rule at >= +5%, loses_to_incumbent_rule at <= -5%, indistinguishable_from_rule between. F: the tree's mean return against a like-for-like ONLINE stump (per-lifecycle running means, cold until its side has seen two actions, valued under the same full-sample means) - drop_overturned_like_for_like only above +5%, drop_holds_like_for_like otherwise. NO ROSTER CHANGE in any branch: DR 0051's verdicts were made by the documented rule and stand; these findings become dated notes beside DR 0051, never a re-score.
decision.pre_run_prediction: Written before the run: the frozen reactive rule is expected to be a far harder opponent than uniform random - the qtable's +55.459% is expected to COLLAPSE toward the +-5% band (indistinguishable_from_rule, direction unknown), because the empirical bucket means are made largely of the rule's own behaviour. The like-for-like online stump is expected to lose some of its oracle advantage, narrowing F's -1.776% toward zero without crossing the +5% bar (drop_holds_like_for_like). Either refutation ships as the finding.

next_research_step: Record both findings as dated notes beside DR 0051; then P5 (the probe artifacts carry their own edges) and P6 (the Phase-P gate).
